preconditions.player_input: Continuous ordinary 0:brake+handbrake after DriveDelay=2. Before setup/control writes and every capture, require actual player0 engine2, at least four fresh advancing MotionProbe samples <=0.25m/s and sampled planar path<=0.5m, at least two fresh physics rows with brake/HB>0.95, gas<=0.05, steer<=0.01, normal contact and crashing=0, with an advancing sample over at least one wall second. The entire post-attach interval retains gross speed<=1m/s and planar displacement<=1m, no engine departure from2, no boost/Showtime/forced freeze and no console reopen after accepted closure. Screening thresholds are proposed; they are not retail constants.
preconditions.natural_hud: Exact Root-reviewed bb_005240.bmp is the accepted stationary natural HUD preflight. Windshield texture may be cracked; intact glass is not a criterion. Root reviews the 62091 baseline plus fifteen selected-state images; the original 62090 result remains unchanged.

preconditions.owned_and_other_game_policy: One owned private 62091 game plus at most one other game with a known absolute image path distinct from the staged executable; strict ownership, PID/image/start, process enumeration, and owned-only cleanup remain required.
